meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的商品信息，按电商文案模板生成带标题、正文和 emoji 的图片文案；也能优化已有文案的标题、正文和 emoji，并输出为 Markdown 格式。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作、文案优化，或需要为电商商品生成营销文案时，就会触发。

say.text: 帮我为这款智能眼罩写一段电商文案，卖点是智能遮光。
say.note: Claude 会按模板生成带 emoji 的完整文案。

say.text: 优化这段文案：充电宝大容量、快充，让它更有吸引力。
say.note: Claude 会改写标题和正文，突出卖点。

say.text: 给环保餐具写文案，强调可降解、健康无毒。
say.note: Claude 会从环保痛点切入生成文案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate image copy with title, body text, and emoji based on your product details, following an e-commerce template. It can also optimize existing copy and output as Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request e-commerce copywriting, copy optimization, or marketing copy for an e-commerce product.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for this smart sleep mask, highlighting smart light blocking.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full copy with emoji from the template.

say_en.text: Optimize this copy: power bank, large capacity, fast charging.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite title and body to highlight selling points.

say_en.text: Write copy for eco-friendly tableware, emphasizing biodegradable and non-toxic.
say_en.note: Claude will start from eco pain points to generate copy.
